name: Fire
source: Pathfinder Rage of Elements, Fire adjustment (pg. 115), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=18
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Rage of Elements is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds the fire trait, Pyric (if it has languages) and immunity to fire; one damage die of each Strike with several becomes fire damage, and a Strike with one die deals 1 extra fire damage.
optional: Optional: If it can cast spells, you can replace spells with fire spells of the same rank, such as: cantrip ignition, 1st breathe fire, 2nd blazing bolt, 3rd fireball, 4th wall of fire, 5th fire's pathway, 6th fireball, 7th fiery body, 8th burning blossoms, 9th falling stars.
